prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1073; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The patient reports pain and reduced grip strength in the right wrist since the event. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a wrist fracture. Over the course of 14 visits, care followed a typical treatment pathway, including immobilization, reassessment of healing, and progressive range-of-motion and strengthening work. Visit frequency tapered as the patient improved and function returned. The patient mentioned a small strain in the same area several years ago that resolved completely with conservative care and no lasting limitation. At this point it is not yet clear whether the current injury came from this crash, and that question should be addressed through further review of the records. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for the services rendered.
